originals.ko: 우리는 그녀가 옳다고 의미할 수 있을 텐데
originals.why: 'mi fydden ni'n medru golygu bod hi'n iawn' (we could mean that she's right) makes no sense with 'ni' as subject. Golygu needs a thing as subject (e.g. 'it could mean'), so this is unnatural Welsh in this LEGO's sense.

originals.ko: 맞아 우리는 그녀가 옳다고 의미할 수 있을 텐데
originals.why: Same problem as o1: 'we could mean that she was right' is semantically unnatural in Welsh and in Korean.
